::: {#def-log-sum-exp}

#### Log-sum-exp

The **log-sum-exp** function maps a vector $\vz \in \reals^C$ to

$$
\operatorname{LSE}(\vz) = \log \sumto{k}{C} \e{z_k}
$$

[@goodfellow2016deep, section 6.2.2.3].
It is the log of the denominator of the [softmax function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/multiclass-logistic-regression.html#def-softmax).
PyTorch provides it as `torch.logsumexp`.
$\operatorname{LSE}(\vz)$ is at least the largest entry of $\vz$ and at most that entry plus $\log C$,
so it is called a smooth maximum.

:::
